before: At parent f9476a61e557bfdce2fbf3ffeaad0988fe47c184, project-context discovery resolved the configured working directory and walked every ancestor to the filesystem root. commit.subject: fix(coding-agent): stop loading AGENTS.md twice in nested git worktrees (#7221)
commit.body_excerpt:
Running from a linked worktree nested under its main repo loaded the
project's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md twice. The ancestor walk climbs from cwd to
the filesystem root, so it picked up the worktree's copy and then the main
repo's copy above it, even though both are the same tracked file.

The walk now drops that one duplicate: the main repo root's copy is skipped
when the worktree root has a context file of the same name. Nothing else
changes. The worktree still inherits the main repo's copy when it has none,
directories above the main repo keep loading, and ordinary repos, sibling
worktrees, submodules and bare layouts are untouched.

commit.subject: fix(file-tools): anchor relative-path resolution to absolute base; report resolved path (#35399)
commit.body_excerpt:
Relative paths in write_file/patch could resolve against the agent PROCESS cwd
instead of the terminal's working directory. In a git-worktree session with a
stale TERMINAL_CWD='.' (a relative base), early edits silently landed in the
MAIN checkout, verified there, and reported success — while the agent inspected
the worktree and saw nothing, misreading it as the patch tool no-op'ing.

- _resolve_base_dir(): resolution base is now ALWAYS absolute. A relative
  TERMINAL_CWD is anchored to the process cwd once, deterministically, instead
  of being left to resolve()-time cwd. Live terminal cwd stays authoritative.
- write_file/patch pass the resolved absolute path to the shell FileOps layer
  so the tool layer and shell layer can't disagree about which file is edited.
- Responses now report the absolute resolved_path and files_modified, so a
  wrong-cwd mismatch is visible on the first call.
- _path_resolution_warning(): emits a _warning when a relative path resolves
  OUTSIDE the live terminal cwd (e.g. a worktree session writing into main).

Validation: 11 new unit tests + 43 live E2E assertions (worktree routing,
mid-session cd, V4A patches, divergence warning, absolute paths, cons

title: Preserve literal file paths containing glob metacharacters across workspace-rooted file tools
before: At parent commit fb3ceb0da4e2cd636013c2c36a9c0016c01aa47f, both file-discovery operations passed user inputs directly to the glob library after only separator normalization in the multi-file reader. Consequently, an existing workspace-relative path containing glob metacharacters such as square brackets was interpreted as a pattern rather than as the literal path, so exact files such as file[1].txt or src/app/[test]/(dashboard)/testing/components/code.tsx could be missed.
after: At commit 6fc68ff8d4536f35f0ed76af535d5e1e7ac37675, each operation resolves an input against every applicable workspace search directory, checks whether that exact path exists, and escapes the input before glob evaluation when it does. Nonexistent inputs remain unescaped and therefore retain wildcard-pattern behavior. Focused tests cover literal bracketed filenames and nested paths containing square brackets and parentheses for both discovery and multi-file reading.
diff: The change imports filesystem existence checks and the glob library's escape helper. The discovery operation now classifies its single input independently for each search directory and escapes an existing literal path. The multi-file reader similarly normalizes and classifies every search input independently for each workspace root, passing escaped existing paths and unchanged nonexisting patterns to glob. Four regression tests were added: two for discovery and two for reading. Existing workspace selection, ignore filtering, containment checks, result formatting, and wildcard behavior were left in place.

evidence_units.claim: Commit 6fc68ff8d4536f35f0ed76af535d5e1e7ac37675 has parent fb3ceb0da4e2cd636013c2c36a9c0016c01aa47f, is titled "fix(tools): Handle special characters in file paths for glob and read_many_files (#6507)", and changes two implementations plus their two test files.
